summary: First testing iteration for ORION cinematic marketing site. Both backend (POST/GET /api/leads) and frontend (preloader, hero, navbar, about, features, how-it-works pinned scroll, tech-stack, contact form, footer) tested end-to-end. All 8 backend pytest tests passed. All 10 frontend Playwright checks passed including form submission with backend persistence verification.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: EmailStr validation works and returns 422 on invalid email — good.
server.py: MongoDB _id properly excluded via projection in GET /api/leads.
server.py: CORS uses env-based origins with '*' fallback — fine for public site.
Contact.jsx uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL correctly — no hardcoded URL.
All interactive elements have data-testid attributes — good testability.

Minor: Hero subtitle text runs two sentences together without a space between '.' and 'A' due to
only visually separating. Verified content: "Obviously Rochat's Intelligent Operating Network. A proactive AI system for automation and intelligent workflows." — cosmetic only.
Minor: server.py stores lead as .model_dump() which serializes EmailStr fine on Motor; no sanitization/duplicate email check — acceptable for waitlist MVP.
seed_data_creation: Created multiple TEST_-prefixed leads in MongoDB via API during testing (test_database.leads).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_leads.py and can be re-run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. Preloader takes ~2.3s — always wait 3s+ before UI interactions. Lenis smooth scroll is active — click nav buttons instead of window.scrollTo. Frontend uses external URL from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Contact form data-testids: contact-name-input, contact-email-input, contact-company-input, contact-message-input, contact-submit-btn, contact-success. Verified lead persistence: POST -> GET returns the lead with newest_first order.
rca of the issue: No issues found — all tested flows work correctly.
